title: Korean-Style Chinese-Style Stir-Fried Jjigae
description: A fusion twist on traditional stir-fry with the bold flavors of Korean jjigae. Caramelized garlic and onions add a sweet depth, while the Chinese stir-fry technique brings a delicate crunch.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the caramelized garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the caramelized onion and cook for 2 minutes, until softened.
Add the Korean chili flakes and cook for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the jjigae and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Add the soy sauce, rice vinegar, and grated ginger. Stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until combined.
Transfer to a serving platter and garnish with green onions.
